confidence_notes: Recent Nuwara Eliya price-index data supports the meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer anchors. Accommodation is a bounded seasonal estimate without live listing checks. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain: the cocktail estimate follows the city's reported standard cocktail-to-draft-beer price relationship, checked against a high-end local hotel menu; wine by the glass is estimated at about twice the local draft-beer price because representative local glass prices were not available.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Nuwara Eliya-specific food and drink price data. Accommodation is estimated for a small Sri Lankan hill-station destination with seasonal tourist demand; no separate comparison city was needed.
